title: Address the six comments on the page
summary: The run addressed Andrei's six open comments on the page. With Only changes, each tab shows only what changed, tabs with no change hide, and the tree of an AI run has read and run tags. A view shows as a page (before and after when it changed), Environment has Browser and Server, and the new Performance tab shows the test time of each function in this version and the one before. The md themes have their own change colors and the MD badge is gone. All 24 tests pass and the commit is 94f44ba.
actions: Put the id of a scheduled task into Notes Settings, New session task, to use Send now new session.

session.words: Reading of the ask: (1) set up a workspace with a git repo for this project's work. No repos are attached yet; check list_repos for a suitable one (e.g. agent_os/agents_os). If none exists, init a local git repo in the workspace and ask Andrei to create a GitHub repo so you can attach and push. (2) Publish an HTML artifact that's otherwise empty and holds the user's JSON, exactly as given in the m
session.why: The session started on 2026-10-24. Its goal is to build the Agent OS page. The page is an artifact. It runs from its JSON state.

run.why: Andrei had six open comment threads on the Agent OS page. They asked for a cleaner file viewer and tree, md change colors per theme, views shown as pages, Only changes in each tab, an Environment with Browser and Server, and Performance between versions. The run had to address all six (v47).

subagents.name: general-purpose (run-recorder)
subagents.why: The main agent started it after the commit. It records this run as runs/<session>-<run>.json for the timeline.

steps.title: Read the six comments and show the plan

items.text: mcp hearthbot post_message: the agent reads the latest comments on the page
search the tools for ArtifactComments and load it
read the comments of the Agent OS page (ArtifactComments): six open threads of Andrei
mcp hearthbot update_progress_checklist: one line for each of the six comments

steps.why: Andrei asked the agent to address the last comments. The comments are on the page, so the agent read them first. The threads are not activated for Claude, so the agent could not reply in them or resolve them.

steps.title: Find the file viewer, the tabs and the changes

items.text: search gen/make_state.py for kindView, fileView, drawEnv and environment
read gen/make_state.py (the kind view, the file viewer and the tree)
search gen/make_state.py for drawChanges, drawPair, touchesOf and drawDetails
read scratchpad/run46b.js: the screenshot script of v46

steps.why: Five of the comments are about the tabs of the state view. The agent read how kindView, fileView and the change pairs draw them.

steps.title: Look at the tabs of v46 in a browser

items.text: create scratchpad/shot.js: screenshots of each tab with the history of v45, v46 and the working state
run node shot.js v46: 13 screenshots (files, views, environment, performance, md styles)
read 6 screenshots: Only changes files and views, the views tab, md reader and night, environment
search gen/make_state.py and gen/style_part.py for the md change colors (chg-, --add, data-md-theme)
read gen/make_state.py (the md pane and its change classes)

steps.why: The agent wanted to see each problem of the comments on the page: the MD badge, the weak md change colors, the views as source and the empty environment and performance tabs.

steps.title: Find the environment, performance and run data

items.text: search index.html and state-core.js for environment, stripRuntime and performance
read index.html (the runtime: environment and performance of a function call)
read state-core.js (stripRuntime and the history)
read runs/2cec6924-58ef-5971-a12c-840df519af08-70.json: the keys, the steps and the context of an AI run
search tests/page.test.js for environment, fv-badge, kv-tabs and performance
mcp hearthbot update_progress_checklist: the comments are read
read gen/make_state.py (KIND_TAB, the table helpers and the state.json writer)

steps.why: The Server side and the Performance tab need data that the state did not have. The agent looked where the runtime keeps environment and performance, and what the run files hold for the AI runs table.

steps.title: Change the state view in the generator

items.text: create scratchpad/p47a.py and run it: md change colors per theme, no MD badge, underline tabs, tree dots and tags
edit gen/make_state.py: changedItems and changedKinds for Only changes, viewPage for the Views tab, Browser and Server sides
edit gen/make_state.py: drawPerformance (avg, max and count) and the Before and After labels of a view
edit gen/make_state.py: environment.server from the generator (machine, runtimes, repo, agent; no secrets)
run gen/make_state.py: a new state.json

steps.why: This is the main change for the six comments. The generator makes the code of the state view, so all the changes went into gen/make_state.py.

steps.title: Collect function times in the page test

items.text: read tests/page.test.js (the end of the page test and the checks of the tabs)
edit tests/page.test.js: write gen/performance.json (count, avg, max of each function from agentOS.calls)
edit tests/page.test.js: checks for Docs with Only changes, the Views tab, Browser and Server, and the Performance tab

steps.why: Andrei wants performance metadata for each function and its change between versions. The page test runs all functions, so it measures them. The generator then puts the times in performance.tests.

steps.title: Check the new tabs in screenshots

items.text: run node shot.js v47 two times: the views, environment and performance tabs, with Only changes
mcp hearthbot update_progress_checklist: the generator part is done
read the screenshots of the views tab and of Only changes files and views
search gen/make_state.py for RENDER and index.html for the mounted views
edit gen/make_state.py: viewPage fills index-view with the mounted views, so a view shows as on the page
read the screenshots again, and of the Performance tab and the Server side

steps.why: The agent checked each new tab on the page. The Page of a view was empty at first, so the agent made index-view fill in the mounted views.

steps.title: Start the tests and update the docs

items.text: test node --test tests/*.test.js in the background (scratchpad/t47a.log); the page test writes gen/performance.json
read gen/docs_part.py and edit it: the tree shows only changes, Page, Source, Changes, Browser and Server, Performance
read gen/pseudo.py and edit it: the pseudo code of the kind view, changedKinds and the Page of a view
edit .claude/CLAUDE.md: a line for the state view of v47
mcp hearthbot no_reply_needed: the tests run

steps.why: The tests take about seven minutes, so the agent updated the docs while they ran. After this the run paused for Andrei's separate questions about the microphone (script runs 106, 107 and 109).

steps.title: Fix the test and lighten the deleted text

items.text: read scratchpad/t47a.log: 23 pass, 1 fail (the header row of the Performance table)
edit tests/page.test.js: read the header cells from the first row of the table
test all tests again in the background (scratchpad/t47b.log)
run node shot.js v47: the md change colors in the reader, night and black styles
read the screenshots of md reader and night
edit gen/make_state.py: a thinner, lighter line-through for deleted md text

steps.why: One check of the page test failed. The cause was the check, not the page. The md screenshots showed that the deleted text was too strong.

steps.title: Commit v47 and start the recorder

items.text: read scratchpad/t47b.log: 24 pass, 0 fail
run gen/make_state.py: state.json and docs with performance.tests
run git commit 94f44ba: 9 files; run scripts/run-log.js for script runs 103 to 112
subagent general-purpose: the run-recorder of run 71, in the background
mcp hearthbot update_progress_checklist and no_reply_needed
create scratchpad/rel47.json: the request and the explain parts for the release of v47

steps.why: All tests pass, so the change is ready. The run file comes from the recorder. The release of v47 uses rel47.json.

run git diff --stat 85e18ec 94f44ba: 9 files changed
read the session log of the run: the edits, the test logs and the commit
fix the file paths that the script read from the commands (cd /home/claude/agent-os;) and add the screenshots
create runs/2cec6924-58ef-5971-a12c-840df519af08-71.json
